description.translate: One last job. I need a new anvil. The old one cracked when the furnace collapsed, and I'm not trusting it with another hammer strike. Bring me an anvil, and we'll call this forge rebuilt. Mostly.

Look at that. A working forge again. You've done more for this place than I expected, and I don't forget a debt. If you ever meet Professor Alden Voss, tell him Garrick Ashford wants to talk. And tell him I believe him now.
